title: Combined Ligament Injury Assessment

positions.as_written: Treat absent or reduced pulses as an arterial injury until it has been excluded properly, rather than as a finding to review later.
Examine the common peroneal nerve next, testing ankle dorsiflexion, great toe extension and sensation over the dorsum of the foot, because this nerve is the one at risk in the posterolateral injury.
Record every test on both knees, because a combined injury is defined by a pattern and a pattern needs a comparison.
